ledger: 00:00 - Small glass jar contains only green olives; large glass jar is completely empty.
00:01 - Green olives are poured from the small jar into the large jar; dark/black olives appear inside the jar during pouring.
00:04 - Large jar contains a mixture of green and dark purple/black olives; performer retrieves more green olives from a side bowl.
00:07 - Performer pours second batch of olives into the main jar, further increasing the count of both green and dark olives.

findings.description: Only green olives are present in the source jar being poured, but dark purple/black olives appear inside the receiving jar as the olives fall, representing an unexplained transformation into a different kind of object.
